## Problem 1 - OOP Programming

### (a) For the waldCI class, define the following:

```{r}
# define the waldCI class
setClass("waldCI",
          slots = c(level = "numeric",
                    mean = "numeric",
                    sterr = "numeric"))

# check waldCI objects have valid calues
setValidity("waldCI", function(object){
  if(object@level <= 0 | object@level >= 1) {
    stop("level must be in (0, 1)")
  }
  if(object@sterr <= 0) {
    stop("stderr must be positive")
  }
  if(!is.finite(object@sterr)) {
    stop("Infinite CI not supported")
  }
  return(TRUE)
})
```
